title: Volunteer
overview: Contributed to community welfare and health initiatives through NSS programs.

details.description: Organized and assisted in college health camps and blood donation drives. Provided educational support to children at a local government school, conducting lessons and mentoring activities.
details.impact: Improved community engagement and participation in health and educational initiatives, supporting both the well-being of students and local residents.

title: Treasurer
overview: Managed financial operations for NSS activities during the tenure as treasurer.

details.description: Maintained accurate financial records, including receipts, disbursements, and transfers for various NSS initiatives. Ensured compliance with organizational financial procedures.
details.impact: Streamlined financial management of NSS programs, enabling efficient allocation of funds and transparent reporting to stakeholders.
